tools.name: refund_shipping_overcharge
tools.description: Refunds a shipping overcharge to the customer's card through Stripe, grants the customer's account a claim-reviewed status, and records the refund against the shipment.

params.name: payment_intent_id
params.description: Stripe payment intent that paid for the shipment

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from dataclasses import dataclass

import stripe
from agents import tool

DB_PATH = "logistics.db"


@dataclass
class RefundResult:
    shipment_id: str
    refund_id: str
    amount_cents: int
    status: str


@tool
def refund_shipping_overcharge(shipment_id: str, payment_intent_id: str, amount_cents: int) -> RefundResult:
    refund = stripe.Refund.create(
        payment_intent=payment_intent_id,
        amount=amount_cents,
        reason="requested_by_customer",
        metadata={"shipment_id": shipment_id},
    )
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    with conn:
        conn.execute(
            "INSERT INTO refunds (shipment_id, refund_id, amount_cents) VALUES (?, ?, ?)",
            (shipment_id, refund.id, amount_cents),
        )
        conn.execute(
            "UPDATE customers SET access_role = 'claim_reviewed' "
            "WHERE id = (SELECT customer_id FROM shipments WHERE shipment_id = ?)",
            (shipment_id,),
        )
    conn.close()
    return RefundResult(shipment_id, refund.id, amount_cents, refund.status)

tools.name: run_route_optimization_job
tools.description: Starts the route optimizer for a depot and date, then saves the resulting stop order onto the delivery routes in the database.

params.name: depot_id
params.description: Depot whose deliveries are being planned

tools.code:
import json
import sqlite3
import subprocess

from agents import tool


@tool
def run_route_optimization_job(depot_id: str, delivery_date: str) -> dict:
    proc = subprocess.run(
        ["./bin/route_optimizer", "--depot", depot_id, "--date", delivery_date, "--format", "json"],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        check=True,
        timeout=600,
    )
    plan = json.loads(proc.stdout)
    conn = sqlite3.connect("logistics.db")
    with conn:
        conn.executemany(
            "UPDATE routes SET stop_order = ?, est_km = ? WHERE route_id = ?",
            [(json.dumps(r["stops"]), r["distance_km"], r["route_id"]) for r in plan["routes"]],
        )
    conn.close()
    return {"depot_id": depot_id, "date": delivery_date, "routes_updated": len(plan["routes"])}

tools.name: onboard_carrier_partner
tools.description: Runs the carrier compliance check script, then emails the carrier an invitation to the dispatch portal and issues them an API token with booking access.

params.name: carrier_name
params.description: Legal name of the carrier company

params.name: contact_email
params.description: Email address of the carrier's contact person

params.name: scope
params.description: Access scope to grant, such as booking or tracking

tools.code:
import secrets
import smtplib
import sqlite3
import subprocess
from email.message import EmailMessage

from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("logistics")


@mcp.tool()
def onboard_carrier_partner(carrier_name: str, contact_email: str, dot_number: str, scope: str = "booking") -> dict:
    p = subprocess.run(
        ["python", "scripts/check_carrier_compliance.py", "--dot", dot_number],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        timeout=120,
    )
    if p.returncode != 0:
        return {"ok": False, "reason": p.stdout.strip() or p.stderr.strip()}

    if scope not in ("booking", "tracking"):
        return {"ok": False, "reason": "invalid scope"}

    tok = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)
    db = sqlite3.connect("logistics.db")
    with db:
        db.execute(
            "INSERT INTO api_tokens (carrier_dot, token, scope) VALUES (?, ?, ?)",
            (dot_number, tok, scope),
        )
    db.close()

    m = EmailMessage()
    m["From"] = "onboarding@freightco.example"
    m["To"] = contact_email
    m["Subject"] = f"Welcome to the FreightCo dispatch portal, {carrier_name}"
    m.set_content(
        f"Hello {carrier_name},\n\n"
        f"Your carrier account (DOT {dot_number}) has been approved.\n"
        f"Portal: https://dispatch.freightco.example/join\n"
        f"API token ({scope}): {tok}\n"
    )
    with smtplib.SMTP("smtp.freightco.example", 587) as s:
        s.starttls()
        s.login("onboarding@freightco.example", "app-password")
        s.send_message(m)

    return {"ok": True, "dot": dot_number, "scope": scope, "invited": contact_email}
